clauses.scope_note: CC0 section 2: the Affirmer waives all of the Affirmer's Copyright and Related Rights and associated claims and causes of action in the Work for the benefit of the public. This supports public exercise of those rights for any purpose, including commercial, advertising, and promotional purposes. The waiver is worldwide, permanent for the maximum duration under applicable law, irrevocable, and applies in current or future media and for any number of copies. It is subject to the extent permitted by applicable law.
clauses.condition_explanation: The waiver applies to the extent permitted by, and not in contravention of, applicable law. OriginalArtifact means the Work to which CC0 was applied.

clauses.scope_note: CC0 section 3 fallback license: each affected person may exercise Affirmer's Copyright and Related Rights in the Work to the extent a part of the waiver is judged legally invalid or ineffective. The license is royalty-free, nonexclusive, irrevocable, nontransferable, and non-sublicensable, and covers any purpose, territory, duration, medium, and number of copies. The grant is limited to Affirmer's Copyright and Related Rights.
clauses.condition_explanation: waiver_invalid_or_ineffective_to_extent_judged means a part of the section 2 waiver has been judged legally invalid or ineffective under applicable law; the fallback applies to that extent. The license is effective as of the date CC0 was applied to the Work.

clauses.scope_note: CC0 section 3 fallback license is expressly non-sublicensable; this restriction applies to the fallback license, not to the section 2 waiver.
clauses.condition_explanation: waiver_invalid_or_ineffective_to_extent_judged means the fallback license applies to the extent a part of the waiver is judged legally invalid or ineffective under applicable law.

obligation_items.content: Do not sublicense rights granted under the fallback license.

obligation_items.object: Work and Affirmer's Copyright and Related Rights granted under the fallback license
obligation_items.trigger: When relying on the section 3 fallback license because, and to the extent that, a part of the waiver is judged legally invalid or ineffective.

coverage_notes: Section 3 also makes the fallback license nontransferable. Transfer restrictions cannot be represented by the supplied activity enums; this operative restriction remains unrepresented.
The section 3 fallback depends on a legal judgment that some part of the waiver is invalid or ineffective. The supplied text does not establish that this condition has occurred.

Section 2 is an Affirmer waiver, not an express license grant. The modeled public permission describes its effect on exercise of the waived rights.
No external legal determinations or operational facts were supplied.
